title: a draft with no status key saves: the saved file gains the line status: approved before its first key, every other byte is kept, and the saved build launches
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, "Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories": a draft may omit status, and build save writes with no owner gate
intent: A draft that launches must also save. The status goes in front of the first key, with that key's indentation and the file's line break, or right after the brace of a one-line mapping, so a comment, a document marker, a block text at the end and a missing final newline stay as written.

files..jitso/briefs/brief.md:
## Goal

Find where the sync entry point of this project is defined and explain in a few sentences how it is wired to the rest of the code.

## Scope

Read only. Do not change any file and do not leave the repository.

## Done when

You can name the file and the line that defines the entry point, and you have checked it by reading the file.

## Report format

One short paragraph with the file path, the line number and a one line summary of what it does.
